description: Mason (Building Constructor) lays brick with mortar and other construction material to construct and repair building walls, arches, chimneys, floors, pillars and other structures. The learner is responsible for site development and clearance, makes support for laying of bricks and blocks, mortar and cement concrete mixing, rendering coat plastering, work related to plumbing, knowledge of scaffolding and have the basic knowledge of environment, health and safety pertaining to the trade.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Perform woodwork with carpenter's tools, masonry and block wall construction, reinforced cement concrete (RCC)
Laying out of building plan, Construction of cavity wall, Wall and ceiling plastering, Formation of floor slope.
Make pipe cutting and jointing, Fixture installation, Trap installation, Septic tank construction, Manhole construction and test the system.
Prepare and mix concrete, Cutting and bending of bar, Lay mosaic, terrazzo and tile flooring, construction of R.C.C. and brick stairs.
